class.name: SVG3D
class.brief_description: Renders SVG markup on a sprite in a 3D scene.
class.description: SVG3D rasterizes SVG markup onto an internal 3D plane. It monitors the active camera and uses a mipmapped texture matching the projected pixel dimensions while keeping its size in 3D space unchanged.

method.name: get_svg_size
method.description: Returns the SVG document's natural dimensions. The editor uses this for picking and generated collision geometry.

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Returns the texture currently displayed on the internal 3D plane.

members.member: Enables the four-frame path jitter animation. Disabled nodes keep one normal texture and do not retain the three animation textures.
Number of rendered frames to hold each jitter pattern. The four fixed patterns cycle in order.

If [code]true[/code], redraws the SVG at its projected integer pixel dimensions through the active camera. The current texture is reused while those dimensions stay unchanged, and each texture axis is limited to 4096 pixels.

Maximum path displacement as a ratio of the SVG document dimensions. The shape moves as a whole while a smaller part of the amount deforms its outline. Used when [member animation_enabled] is enabled.
Multiplies the SVG texture color and opacity.
Moves the texture in SVG natural units, independently of the adaptive raster resolution.
The size of one SVG unit in 3D space. Adaptive texture changes do not change this visible size.
An SVG file path to render on the 3D sprite, such as [code]res://art/icon.svg[/code]. Complete SVG markup is also accepted for compatibility and generated images.
